not_met.lacks: A would-be user finds and installs the plugin only through the marketplace's listing in /plugin, and the practices count on that listing: plugin/best-practice.md:331 runs the check on the marketplace, plugin/best-practice.md:339 has the marketplace and the root README list each release, and plugin/best-practice.md:355 speaks of the plugin's marketplace entry. Yet the template holds nothing for the plugin's place in the marketplace or the root README, and its order of files at plugin/template/README.md:10 never reaches them. A generator that fills every section can still hand over a plugin that no user finds or can install, and nothing in the template shows it what that place holds.

not_met.lacks: Two places tell the generator to write the manifest's description from the plugin's product vision: plugin/best-practice.md:355 says to write it from the opening of the product vision, and plugin/template/.claude-plugin/plugin.json:2 asks for the words of the product vision's users. But Inputs at plugin/best-practice.md:13 names only architecture. Setting that section against what fills it, the generator doesn't find the product vision among the kinds it makes a plugin from, so the plan hands it no product vision. It then writes the description, which a would-be user decides by, from a deliverable that nobody gave it, or from what the architecture retells.
